headline: Gilford the Lightning
title: Gilford the Lightning Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Gilford the Lightning. What is it? It is a Level eight LIGHT Warrior with two thousand eight hundred attack. What does it do? You can Tribute three monsters to Tribute Summon it, and if you do, destroy all monsters your opponent controls. How do you use it? With two Tributes it is just a big attacker, so save three weak monsters or tokens for the full wipe. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
